title: Deterministic value-oracle complexity (example)
statement: Resolve completely the polynomial dependence on d of the deterministic exact-value oracle complexity Q_det(d, d^-4) for minimizing 1-Lipschitz convex functions on the Euclidean unit ball B_d, using only an exact function-value oracle. Identify the explicit exponent (or explicit q(d)) and prove matching upper and lower bounds up to polylogarithmic factors.
references: Protasov (1996), Algorithms for approximate calculation of the minimum of a convex function from its values. Woodworth & Srebro (2019), Open Problem: The Oracle Complexity of Convex Optimization with Limited Memory. Marsden, Sharan, Sidford & Valiant (2022), Efficient Convex Optimization Requires Superlinear Memory. Blanchard, Zhang & Jaillet (2023), Quadratic Memory is Necessary for Optimal Query Complexity in Convex Optimization.
